items.title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
items.en_title: DaisyRose-27B: Pushing the Frontier of Post-Training Efficiency
items.en_oneliner: RadixArk's 27B-parameter DaisyRose explores getting stronger model performance from less post-training effort.

items.title: v0.24.0
items.en_oneliner: The Agents SDK ships version 0.24.0, unifying run-wide function error formatting and adding MCP discovery annotations, while improving recovery, sandbox safety, and tracing.

items.title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
items.en_title: Why your fine-tuning job takes longer than the FLOPs say
items.en_oneliner: A hands-on analysis from Hugging Face explains why fine-tuning often runs longer than FLOPs estimates suggest, and how to predict its time more reliably.

items.title: Genie 4 is now available
items.en_oneliner: DeepMind's interactive world model Genie 4 is now open, turning text or image prompts into explorable worlds you can move through in real time.

items.title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
items.en_title: The Gemini app is now available on lower-memory Android devices.
items.en_oneliner: The Gemini app has lowered the memory bar for Android devices, so phones with less memory can now use Gemini Live and custom image creation.

items.title: Customize GitHub Copilot for your team
items.en_title: Customize GitHub Copilot for your team
items.en_oneliner: Team customizations are now generally available for organization teams, letting members share the Copilot plugins the team relies on without repeating the same setup individually.
